note: Wave two of the 4 Sep 2026 10.04 PM WhatsApp export — the five teams wave one deliberately skipped because they already had listings on the store: Portugal, Argentina, England, Italy and the Netherlands. Photo keys are p1..p149 in the export's timestamp order, staged by scripts/stage-0904c.py, and are the same numbers batch-0904c-research.md and unlisted-audit-2026-09-05.md use. 87 products from 115 photographs.
identificationMethod: Three passes. (1) The garment-type captions the client sends with each photo, recovered off WhatsApp Web from 9:14 PM on — so Argentina, England, Italy and the Netherlands are caption-confirmed. Portugal's captions (9:10-9:14 PM) are past WhatsApp's history floor and were read from the photographs alone. (2) Contact sheets read by eye, per stadium-supply-rugby-batch: perceptual hashing does not separate garments on a flat backdrop. Fan versus player was settled on the neck label and the crest — DRYCELL/embroidered crest is fan, ULTRAWEAVE or DRI-FIT ADV with a heat-pressed crest is player. (3) A 16x16 dHash of every batch photo against all 327 images on the 44 live Portugal/Argentina/England/Italy/Netherlands listings. That does not group garments, but it does catch the same supplier photograph being reused, and it found five exact reuses.
dedupeNote: Dedupe was against every live listing for these five teams, not against titles. Held as already listed: p21 (Portugal home fan — Portugal 2024/25 Home Jersey), p82 (England home fan — England 2024/25 Home Jersey), p43 (Argentina white half-zip set), p55 (Argentina away fan, filigree — the listing filed as Argentina 2010 Away Retro Jersey, which is mislabelled: the photographs show a current adidas Originals shirt with a FIFA 2022 badge), p85/p86/p87/p91/p93/p94/p96/p97 (Italy training set, half-zip, home fan, away fan, two Puma retros, home kids, away long-sleeve player) and p103/p104/p105/p107/p109/p110/p113 (Netherlands home long-sleeve fan, away fan, home kids, away kids, away player, home player, 2008 white away retro). p87, p91, p103, p107 and p115 were confirmed by exact photo reuse (dHash distance 4-7). Merged inside the batch: p66 and p68 are one garment (England 2007/09 home long sleeve) photographed twice, and p15/p16 are the front and back of the Portugal red anthem jacket.
heldBack: Five full-zip tracksuits are NOT imported because the client has never priced a full zip — Argentina p40/p41 and Italy p101 (all captioned 'full zip', held out of wave one for the same reason) and Portugal p11/p12, which have no caption but are jacket-and-pants sets. The jacket tier is R1 000 and the training-set tier R600; a full tracksuit sits between them and the call is the client's. Also held: Netherlands p112 and p115, the adult 1988 chevron home and away. The store carries those two only as '1988 Netherlands Home/Away Retro Kids Kit' — but p115 is the SAME photograph as the away kids listing (dHash 5), so listing them again would read as a duplicate rather than an adult size range. Ask the client whether they stock the 1988 chevrons in adult sizes before creating them.
assumptions: Two flagged. (1) Portugal p9 and p10 (the Puma white dotted-wave away and the Puma red home) are listed as retros. With no caption they could be a current-range kit; the Puma-era styling and the plain crest read retro. (2) Portugal's fan/player split on p22-p29 is read from the fabric and the neck label, not from the client's word, because that stretch of the thread is unrecoverable. Each wrong call is R150 on one listing.
priceNote: The client's own tier table, as applied to the whole catalogue by scripts/apply-client-pricing.mjs. Long sleeve is the client's '+R100 if available', so fan long sleeve is R600, player long sleeve R750 and retro long sleeve R800. The jacket tier (R1 000) is new in this manifest — wave one contained no outerwear — and covers windbreakers, anthem jackets and track tops, matching the f1-outerwear batch.
seasonNote: A year is asserted only where the shirt itself carries the design or sponsor that dates it. Where it does not, the listing is titled by colourway or manufacturer era instead of claiming a season the photograph cannot support.
